title: The text of a version
description: The text of a version of an EU act in one language, in version 1 of the API. A later minor change can add members, so a client ignores the members it does not know.

version.description: Where the version is among the versions of the act: oj, or the date from which it applies.

celex.description: The CELEX number of the document that holds the text.

language.description: The language, by the EU's code. For example, eng.

links.description: The links of the answer, by their relation. A relation is in the IANA registry, or is a relation of this API with the prefix av.

href.description: The address, or a URI template if templated is true.

hreflang.description: The language of the target. For example, en.

legalText.description: A legal text in the public model. The text is in parts, as the Official Journal prints it. A part holds blocks. Running text has two forms: plain text, and HTML in a closed list of elements.

preamble.description: The formulas, the citations and the recitals.

conclusions.description: The closing formula and the signatures.

annexes.description: The annexes and the documents attached to the act.

footnotes.description: The footnotes, from wherever they are in the text.

text.description: The plain text, as printed. It leaves out the markers of footnotes and the words that an amendment deleted. A line break is a line feed.

html.description: The text as HTML. It uses only these elements: b, i, u, s, sup, sub, span (with class uc, sc, expanded or box; with lang; or with data-act and data-modification), time (with datetime), cite, a (with href), br, img (with data-file), ins, del, and math in MathML.

block.description: A thing that stands on its own lines. Its type tells which. A validator checks only the schema of that type: a block can hold blocks, so checking each block against every schema would take time that grows with the depth of the text.

tags.description: The tags of a consolidated version that name the acts that gave the block its wording, the outermost first.

tag.description: A tag of a consolidated version: the act that gave the text its wording, and what it did.

act.description: The CELEX number of the amending act.

occurrence.description: An article, a paragraph, a point, an annex and so on.

eId.description: Its identifier in the text. For example, art_3/par_2/pnt_a.

kind.description: What it is. For example, article or point. The list can grow.

num.description: Its label as printed. For example, Article 3 or (a).

table.description: A table. A group of rows starts with its heading row.

footnotes.description: The footnotes of the table, numbered in it.

header.description: Present if it is a heading row.
Present if it is a heading cell.

file.description: The image file, as the Publications Office names it in the act's files.

description.description: The text in the image, written out.

quotation.description: Text that an amending act quotes: the occurrences that it inserts or replaces in another act. It is not law of this act.

keptDeletion.description: A kept deletion: blocks that an act deleted, which the consolidated version still shows under the tag of that act. They are not in force.

footnote.description: A footnote. The href of its marker in the HTML is # and its eId.
